module uart_07 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);

  reg [7:0] baud_count;
  reg [2:0] state;
  reg [7:0] data_reg;
  reg start_detected;
  
  // States for auto-baud detection
  localparam S_IDLE   = 3'd0;
  localparam S_WAIT_0 = 3'd1;
  localparam S_MEAS   = 3'd2;
  localparam S_DONE   = 3'd3;
  
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      state <= S_IDLE;
      baud_count <= 8'd0;
      data_reg <= 8'd0;
      start_detected <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        S_IDLE: begin
          if (in_data == 8'h55) begin
            state <= S_WAIT_0;
            baud_count <= 8'd0;
          end
        end
        
        S_WAIT_0: begin
          if (in_data[0] == 1'b0) begin
            state <= S_MEAS;
            baud_count <= 8'd0;
          end else begin
            state <= S_IDLE;
          end
        end
        
        S_MEAS: begin
          baud_count <= baud_count + 8'd1;
          if (in_data[0] == 1'b1) begin
            state <= S_DONE;
            data_reg <= baud_count;
          end
        end
        
        S_DONE: begin
          state <= S_IDLE;
        end
        
        default: begin
          state <= S_IDLE;
        end
      endcase
    end
  end
  
  assign out_data = data_reg;

endmodule

  reg [2:0] state;
  reg [7:0] data_reg;

  localparam S_IDLE   = 3'd0;
  localparam S_WAIT_0 = 3'd1;
  localparam S_MEAS   = 3'd2;
  localparam S_DONE   = 3'd3;

  localparam S_WAIT_0 = 3'd1;
  localparam S_MEAS   = 3'd2;
